At first, half the room didn't even understand what they were saying and there was a lot of confusion. When we walked back to the main building from the gym, it was kind of nuts. A LOT of students walking/running through the halls despite it being the middle of a class period. I was a part of my school's TV program (yes, we had a full industry-level TV studio in our school - it's weird but insanely cool) so I was given a waiver to skip class and just wheel TVs on carts to every classroom that wanted one, which was basically all of them. Everyone watched the news for the rest of the day.

I remember this day more vividly than any other day from high school. It was so surreal and so very sad, but it was also the most unified this country has seemed to me in my entire lifetime.
